name: mldr-r1
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; set +e; GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken 2>/tmp/mldr-incl.err; s=$?; tail -c 12000 /tmp/mldr-incl.err; echo BASELINE_EXIT=$s; if [ $s = 0 ] || [ $s = 124 ] || [ $s = 137 ]; then exit 0; else exit $s; fi
